Trump proposes splitting MMR vaccine; doctors advise against it

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has expressed a desire to administer the Measles, Mumps, and Rubella (MMR) vaccine in three separate doses instead of the standard single shot. Medical experts, including doctors, have stated that this approach is a bad idea. The coverage does not specify when or where Trump made this proposal, nor does it detail the specific reasons behind his suggestion or the exact concerns raised by medical professionals.
